scope: Optional LLM classification, precedence, confidence metadata and controls; not full M4 acceptance
checks: One ING-8 type precedence rule is shared between classification and publication. Overrides, door/frontmatter declarations, unambiguous transcript formats, and source rules skip model calls.
Classification uses the configured enrich role with a bounded UTF-8 excerpt, at most 512 output tokens, a 30-second deadline, no tools, structured JSON where supported and bounded tolerant parsing.

Low-confidence, malformed, budget-limited, unavailable and timed-out results fall through to the format default. Shutdown cancellation propagates, and actual/unknown usage settles through the shared ledger.
Results are cached as bounded metadata in extraction jobs. Store restart preserves the cache. Changes to the document/source/configuration fence stale results before publication.
Winning origin and confidence are persisted with effective properties; original properties are preserved. Document metadata and the viewer expose model confidence.
Validated classification settings are editable with session step-up and reload without restart. They apply to subsequent processing.
Expected YAML aliases, service registrations and OpenAPI schema additions were reviewed. No schema migration or package change was required.
limitations: Enrichment summaries/tags/mentions/link suggestions, batch backfill and frontmatter write-back remain unimplemented.
Already processed documents are not automatically reclassified solely because the settings change.
The local classification qualification uses a synthetic article; the separate real VTT check exercised import and speaker citations.
Hardened deployment, sustained-write daemon restore, external mount-point and large-corpus qualification, remaining provider adapters and release operations remain open.
